units: <cite ref="Mishnah Keritot 5:1">Ker. V, 1</cite> <he>דם ה׳ שהנפש יוצאה בו</he> the blood of arteries with which life goes out, i.e. the splashing blood; <cite ref="Keritot 22a:34">ib. 22ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 29a">Sabb. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>סעודת ה׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>ה׳ דם</he>) the meal taken after blood-letting; a. fr.
